root_cause.text: The `madvise_args_are_sane()` function in the Intel Xe DRM driver fails to validate that the user-supplied `args->pat_index.val` is within the bounds of `xe->pat.n_entries` before passing it to `xe_pat_index_get_coh_mode()`, leading to an out-of-bounds read from the `xe->pat.table` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_vm_madvise.c` adds a bounds check `args->pat_index.val >= xe->pat.n_entries` and uses `array_index_nospec()` to sanitize the index before passing it to `xe_pat_index_get_coh_mode()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Validate and sanitize the PAT index input to prevent speculative out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: Added a boundary check for args->pat_index.val against xe->pat.n_entries and sanitized the index using array_index_nospec before retrieving the coherence mode.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds memory access and mitigates speculative execution side-channel vulnerabilities (Spectre v1) by bounding the array index.

grouping_result.intent: Validate and sanitize the PAT index input to prevent speculative out-of-bounds access.
